tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /gnod sbyin 'khor lo'i bsgrub tshul phun tshogs kun 'byung bzhugs// nā mo gu ru bud+dha dh+wa dza ye/ phun tshogs kun 'byung bla ma la btud de/ /phun tshogs 'byung gnas gnod sbyin 'khor lo yi/ /phun tshogs bsgrub pa'i man ngag zab mo 'di/ /phun tshogs ma lus 'byung phyir 'dir spel lo/ /de la 'dir dpa' bo gcig sgrub kyi rgyud nas gsungs pa'i gnod sbyin 'khor lo la bri ba dang bsgrub pa'i tshul gnyis gsungs pa las/ dang po bri ba'i sngon du yang lugs 'di rang gi bsnyen pa bya dgos par gsung rab du ma nas 'byung yang / de ni phyag len rgyas pa'i phyogs yin par grub na phun sum tshogs mod/ ma grub kyang 'khor lo bri ba'i tshul shar chen ye shes rgyal mtshan sogs kyi gsung rab nas 'byung ba ltar byas la/ de nas 'khor lo bsgrub pa'am/ mnyes pa'i cho ga la 'jug par bya ste/ de ltar rung ba'i tshul ni/ rje btsun chen po'i man ngag las/ gtso bo yab yum gyi sngags 'bum phrag bzhi sngon du bsnyen pa byas la/ las rnams bsgrub par bya ba yin no/ /de lta bu'i bsnyen pa grub kyang rung / ma grub kyang rung mnyes par bya ba'i cho ga ni/ zhes sogs gsungs pas mnyes pa'am bsgrub pa'i cho ga byed pa la sngon du bsnyen pa ma byas kyang rung bar gsungs la/ rgyud las kyang kha sbyar du byas te mnyes par bya na/ zhes dang / rab gnas don gsal las kyang bskyed la mnyes pa'i cho ga bya'o/ /zhes dang / de nas gnod sbyin mnyes par bya ba'i 'khor lo'i zhabs bsdam mo/ /zhes gsungs te 'khor lo mnyes pa'am/ bsgrub pa'i cho ga byed pa la/ nges par lugs 'di nyid rang gi bsnyen pa sngon du bya dgos pa ma gsungs shing / rjes 'jug gi gsung rab tshad ldan du ma las kyang de ltar bshad pas lugs 'di mi rung bar sems pa'i log rtog bya dgos pa ma yin no/ /de ltar nges par byas nas gong du bshad pa ltar gnod sbyin gyi 'khor lo gsung rab tshad ldan gzhan nas 'byung ba 'khrul med yid brtan thub nges pa'i lag len bgyis pa'i 'khor lo gnyis gsum sogs gang dgos sta gon byas la/

de la thog mar rab gnas bya ba ni rab rgyal phur 'dzoms pa dang / de min na'ang skar ma rgyal la yod pa'i tshes la zangs gzhong la sogs par 'bru dang sman dang / dar snas bkang ba'i steng du 'khor lo gnyis pa kha gyen la phye la bzhag pa mdun du bkod pa'i mdun ngos su/ mchod yon sngon 'gro'i mchod pa lnga bsham/ gtor ma/ ting lo/ chang bu/ gu gul/ yungs dkar/ me tog rnams kyang 'dus byas/ rang gi mdun du rdo rje dril bu bzhag la/ 'khor lo la phyogs par sgrub pa po bsdad la/ bdag bskyed rang gang byed sngon du song nas/ ting phor gsum du mtheb kyu bcug la chus bran la/ 'khor lo la re res kyang g.yas su lan gsum re bskor la/ oṃ sarba bigha nan/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yoḥbi shwa mu khe bh+ye/ sarba tha khaṃ ut+gā te/ s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na gṛh+ne daṃ ba l̥ṃ te swāhā/ zhes brjod la rngan pa byin la bgegs bskrad do/ /de nas sgron me chang bu dang bcas pas rten la g.yas su lan gsum bskor zhing ni sum+bha brjod la/ zhi drag phyed mas sbyang bas phyir dor/ /de nas 'khor lo spos kyis gdugs/ yungs dkar gyis brabs la/ oṃ sarba bigha nan tā krita hūm̐ hūm̐ gis bgegs drag pos sbyangs/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bh-i ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐ gis khrus byas la/ oṃ swa bha wa shud+dha sarba dharmā swa bha wa shud+dho3haṃḥ 'khor lo mi dmigs te stong pa'i ngang las rma byas btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du hrīḥlas 'od dpag med dmar po phyag gnyis mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgya can/ dar gyi stod g.yogs dang / sham thabs can/ rin po che'i rgyan dang / rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs khar hūm̐/ hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas sangs rgyas rnams 'od dpag med pa'i rnam par oṃ badz+ra sa mā dza/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ yang thugs kha nas 'od 'phros pas/

'og min nas sangs rgyas thams cad oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ de'i dpral bar oṃ las 'khor lo dkar po oṃ gyis mtshan pa/ mgrin par āḥlas pad+ma dmar po āḥs mtshan pa/ snying khar hūm̐ las rdo rje sngon po hūm̐ gis mtshan pa'o/ /yang thugs kha nas 'od 'phros pas/ dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor bcas oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las rang 'dra'i rigs bdag gis dbu brgyan/ de nas mchod pa bsang sbyangs byin gyis brlabs la/ oṃ a mṛ ta bha wa hri maṇ+ḍal so sor sbyar ba'i ar+gham̐ nas shap+da'i bar gyis mchod nas/ ghaṇ+ḍe ra ṇas rol mo phul/ 'dod chags rdo rje chos kyi sku/ /kun rtog ye shes rdo rje'i sku/ /ting 'dzin chen po phyag rgya can/ /phyag 'tshal snang ba mtha' yas la/ /mchod bstod zhu ba las byung ba'i 'khor lor gyur par bsam/ 'khor lo la bkod pa'i sngags re re la yang brgya rtsa re/ ye dharmāḥbargya rtsa brgyad bzlas la brtan par bya'o/ /me tog gtor zhing oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swāhā/ yang yang brjod/ de nas 'khor lo gnyis kyi pad 'dab kyi mtshams rnams su mar dang / sbrang rtsi dang / sha ka ra bsres pas byugs la/ pho 'khor steng dang mo 'khor 'og tu byas la yab yum so sor 'grig par kha sbyar la/ dar ram ras sam bal skud ser pos 'khor lo mi mngon par dkris la/ skud pa'i lhag mas pho 'khor gyi steng gi dbus su mdud log khug pa can byas la bzhag mchod rdzas dman pa rnams bsdu'o/ /de nas mnyes pa'i bsgrub pa dngos ni/ gnas khang yid du 'ongs bar bla bre dang yol ba la sogs pas brgyan pa'i sar/ dar ram ras la sogs pa gzhi ser po'i steng du/ zangs gzhong 'bras la sogs pa'i 'bru bzang pos bkang la/ gser/ g.yu/ spos shel/ byi ru/ mu tig sogs bcal du bkram pa'i steng du 'khor lo kha sbyar zhal lhor bstan pa'i sngar gyi mdud khug la gzungs thag ser po btags la de'i steng du dar ser po'i gur phub/

mtha' mar g.yas skor du mchod pa bzang po spyi dang mthun par bshams/ shar du kha zas bzang dgus brgyan pa'i gtor ma chen po gcig bshams/ cha gsum gtor ma yang bshams/ de nas 'di nyid dam/ de min rab gsang 'dus sogs bla med kyi dkyil 'khor gang rung gcig tu dbang bskur ba thob cing dam tshig dang ldan pa bzhi yan chad ci rigs pa gral du 'khod/ mdun du rdo rje dril bu dang bcas pas mchod pa byin gyis brlabs la/ bdag bskyed bsgom pa ni/ rang gi yi dam gang byed kyi bsgom bzlas byas pas rung ste/ rje sems dpa' chen pos mus pa'i lha chen gyi 'khor lo'i bsgrub pa'i dus bdag bskyed rnam rgyal la mdzad pas de ltar byas kyang shin tu legs te/ rje btsun gyi dpa' bo grub pa'i ṭik+ka las 'di rnams bsgrub pa'i bdag gi rnal 'byor/ rang gi yi dam mam 'di nyid kyi 'jam dbyangs dpa' bo grub pa gang rung gis bya'o/ /gsungs pa'i rang gi yi dam gyi dgongs par grub bo/ /zhes 'jam dbyangs sangs rin gyi gsung rab las 'byung ngo / /de nas rang gi mdun gyi 'khor lo bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba'i hūm̐ las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pa las byung ba'i srung ba'i 'khor lo'i nang du/ bh+rūm̐ las byung ba'i gzhal yas khang gi dbus su pam̐ las sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte ba dang 'dab ma rnams la a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor re re/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du kham̐ las rin po che 'bras kyi snye ma wam̐ gis mtshan pa las lha mo nor rgyun ma de dang dus mnyam du 'dab ma rnams la skad cig gis/ shar du zla 'od ma/ lhor sbyin ma/ nub tu dbang sbyin ma/ byang du 'phags ma/ shar lhor rab tu bzang mo/ lho nub tu rus sbal ma/ nub byang du mdzes ma/ byang shar du dbyangs can ma/ gtso 'khor thams cad sku mdog gser btso ma lta bu/ g.yas brkyang gis phyed krung gis bzhugs pa/

phyag g.yas shing thog bi dza pu ra ka bsnams pas yab kyi mgul pa la 'khyud pa/ g.yon gyis 'bras kyi snye ma bsnams pa/ rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ bud med sgyu ma'i nga rgyal gyis 'gyings pa/ nu 'bur zung dang ldan pa/ rin po che 'bar ma skyug par gyur pa'i pad+ma'i gter mnan pa'o/ /gtso mo'i sku g.yas kyi steng du dzam̐ las bi dza pu ra dzam̐ gis mtshan pa las dzam̐ bha la de dang dus mnyam du phyogs kyi lha mo rnams kyi sku g.yas kyi steng du yang skad cig gis/ shar du nor bu bzang po/ lhor gang ba bzang po/ nub tu gnod sbyin ma/ byang du rnam thos sras/ shar lhor rol pa'i phreng ba/ lho nub tu 'dzam bu 'khyil pa/ nub byang du gdong gi dbang po/ byang shar du spyod pa'i dbang po/ gnod sbyin thams cad kyang sku mdog gser btso ma lta bu/ g.yas bi dza pu ra ka g.yon ne'u le 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ dar sna tshogs kyi na bzas mdzes pa'o/ /gtso 'khor thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlabs/ ye shes pa gzhug dbang bskur te thams cad la rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbu brgyan/ de nas mchod la/ phun tshogs dge legs kun 'byung bcom ldan ma/ /dpal dang 'byor ba'i dbang phyug nor rgyun ma/ /yid la re ba'i bkra shis stsol mdzad ma/ /bsam 'phel dkyil 'khor dbang phyug ma la bstod/ /ces dang / nor gyi dbang phyug rin chen gter mnga' zhing / /zhes tshig bcad kyis bstod la/ bzlas pa bya ba ni/ gzungs thag nas bzung la rang gi snying kha nas sngags kyi phreng ba 'od zer ser po 'phro ba gzungs thag la brten nas song bas mdun bskyed kyi thugs khar phog pas de'i rgyud bskul de dag las 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' la phog pas de thams cad kyi thugs ka nas rgyas pa'i dngos grub thams cad spyan drangs/ mdun bskyed kyi lha dang yon bdag la phog pas/

mdun bskyed byin rlabs can dang / yon bdag gi tshe dang bsod nams rgyas par gyur par bsam la sngags spel tshig can bzlas te/ gcig la mtshon na/ oṃ ba su dhā ri ṇi yai mā ma da nam̐ de hi de hi swāhā/ zhes pa'i spel tshig thams cad bcug la/ bzlas grangs ni ci mang gyis na bzang / de ltar gong gi spel tshig rigs 'gre sbyar ba'i lha so so'i sngags ni 'di yin te/ oṃ tsaṇ+ḍa kan+d+yai swāhā/ oṃ ḍ+yai swāhā/ oṃ su dad+d+yai swāhā/ oṃ ār+ya yai swāhā/ oṃ su bha pra yai swāhā/ oṃ gup+ta yai swāhā/ oṃ de w+yai swāhā/ oṃ sa ra swa ta yai swāhā/ zhes pa yum rnams dang / oṃ dzam+bha la dza len+d+ra ya swāhā/ oṃ ma ṇi bhā dra ya swāhā/ oṃ pur+ṇa bha dra ya swāhā/ oṃ dha na dā ya swāhā/ oṃ bai shrā ma ṇa ya swāhā/ oṃ ka li mā li ni ye swāhā/ oṃ pi tsi kuṇ+ḍa li ye swāhā/ oṃ mu khen+d+ra ya swāhā/ oṃ tsa ran+dha ya swāhā/ zhes pa yab rnams so/ /de nas gtor ma yi ge gsum gyis bdud rtsir byin gyis brlabs te/ mtshan sngags la/ i daṃ ba liṃ kha kha/ khā hi khā hi sarba sid+dhi me pra ya tshan tu swāhā/ zhes pas phul/ mchod bstod bsdus pa byas nas 'dod don la gsol ba btab/ cha gsum gtor ma btang / de nas mchod bstod bya/ 'khor lo la brtan bzhugs bya/ bkra shis kyi tshigs bcad brjod/ de lta bu thun gsum gyi rim pas zhag bdun yan ci rigs par bya'o/ /de nas rten gyi pad+ma'am/ khri sogs sam/ bang mdzod la sogs par zas nor bzang po dang lhan cig tu bzhag nas mchod na dngos grub stsol bar mdzad do/ /bsgrub pa yun ring thung ni dmigs ltas dang sbyar te/ rmi lam du nor mang po sbyin pa dang / gdan khri bzang po la bsdad pa dang / sgrub pa po yon bdag rgyan bzang pos brgyan pa sogs dmigs ltas bzang po ma byung gi bar du bsgrub bo/ /grub pa dang 'khor lo rten gyi nang du bcug pa'am/

de min bang mdzod du 'jog na kham phor ser po kha sbyar ba'i nang du pho 'khor steng du yod par bcug la/ 'khor lo'i steng 'og tu 'bru dang / sman sna/ dar sna/ rin po che yang blug la dar ser gyis dkris la/ bkur sti bzang po byas pas 'byor pa rgyas par 'gyur ro/ /'di yi dgos pa ni sbyin bdag gi rten gsum bzhengs nas de yi phyogs su dngos po phal cher btang pas phyis nor med par song na/ rten gsum dang bstan pa la smod cing las rgyu 'bras la bskur ba 'debs pa 'byung bas/ de spang ba'i phyir/ dpal 'byor rgyas pa'i 'phrul 'khor 'di byas pas dpal dgur 'gyur zhes bya ste/ lo gcig gi nang du/ rten gyi nang du gang song dgu 'gyur 'byung ba'i phan yon gsungs pas de'i dgos pa yod cing / rten de la yang mchod pa rgyun mi 'chad pa dang tshul bzhin bsgrubs pa'i 'khor lo gang du yod kyang / phyogs der dgos 'dod char ltar 'bab pa'i phan yon dpag tu med pa 'byung ba yin no/ /zhes pa 'di ni rab tu gnas pa don gsal sogs rab gnas kyi yig cha rnams la gsal byed du dmigs pa dang / lhag par sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po kun dga' rin chen gyis mdzad pa'i rab gnas dngos grub 'byung ba las rten gyi gzungs rdzongs la med thabs med pa'i gnod sbyin 'khor lo bsgrub tshul kho bos logs su bris pa ltar shes par bya'o zhes gsungs 'dug kyang gsung rtsom gnang ma grub 'dug pa nas sngags 'chang mtshungs med de nyid kyi dgongs pa rdzogs thabs su dmigs te/ gnod sbyin pho 'khor mo 'khor bsgrub pa'am mnyes pa'i cho ga phun tshogs kun 'byung zhes bya ba 'di ni/ 'jam dpal dpa' bo grub pa'i rgyud dang / de'i 'grel pa slob dpon su bha ka ras mdzad pa dang / rje btsun chen po grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i dpa' bo grub pa'i man ngag dang / rab gnas don gsal dang / dpa' bo grub pa'i rgyud kyi mchan dang /

snga rabs kyi bla ma shar chen ye shes rgyal mtshan dang / rdo rje 'chang gi dngos slob gu na'i mtshan dang / nam dge sogs kyis rdo rje 'chang gi gsung rgyun bris pa'i yig cha dang / rje sangs rgyas rin chen sogs kyis mdzad pa'i gsung rab 'ga' zhig dang / brgyud pa'i man ngag la brten te/ mi 'phrogs pa'i mkhyen rab dang thugs rje tshad med pa mnga' ba/ sku tshe dpag tu med pa'i sngon rol nas/ rang dang gzhan gyi grub pa'i mtha' rgya mtsho'i pha rol tu son pas/ sku'i skye ba 'dir mkhas grub rnams kyi gtsug gi nor bu lta bur gyur cing / dpal ldan bla ma dam pa drug pa rdo rje 'chang chen po dang dbyer med pa'i 'jam pa'i dbyangs bsod nams dbang po dang rgyal sras grags pa'i mtshan can sprul pa'i sku sku mched dang / rdo rje 'chang mus chen bud+dha'i mtshan can sogs kyi zhabs rdul la yan lag mchog gis gus pas gtugs pa sa skya pa shākya'i dge bsnyen theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos/ 'jam dbyangs chos kyi rgyal po sku mched gyi nang rten dngul gdung ngo mtshar can gnyis sogs rten bzhengs rgya dpangs che ba bgyis skabs/ lcags bya zla ba brgyad pa'i dmar cha'i tshes la rten 'brel legs cha dang bcas dpal sa skya'i lha chen rig 'dzin pho brang du sbyar ba 'dis rang gzhan kun la phan bde bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'byung bar gyur cig/ //sarba maṅga laṃ// //gcig zhus// ༈ mkhan chen a pad rin po che'i dgongs bzhed ltar gu rus zhabs zhu bgyis pa'o// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 a myes zhabs/ gnod sbyin 'khor lo'i sgrub tshul phun tshogs kun 'byung / PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
